sections.Profile:
The "Jolly Ride" pinball machine, produced by Spanish manufacturer Playmatic in 1974, is an electro-mechanical game available in single-player, two-player, and four-player versions. The playfield features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, two standup targets, and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: Playmatic
- Years made: 1974
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Roller Coaster, Rides, Original Theme, 1970s, Theme park
